g.data-flaw: The headline is split CARVER & THE / FLOOD over two bands and the original green FLOOD is left in the artwork.
g.data-outlook: Fixable: huge heavy letters are classed as solid artwork even at a larger solid radius, so detection needs a size-aware test.
g.title: I know this conversion is flawed. The headline is split CARVER & THE / FLOOD over two bands and the original green FLOOD is left in the artwork. Fixable: huge heavy letters are classed as solid artwork even at a larger solid radius, so detection needs a size-aware test.
